title: 第21章 四王杀阵第22章 叫板王长东
content_zh:
半个月里，林炎一直沉浸在闭关之中。
实际上开辟气海，早在七天之前就已经完成了，林炎已经踏入了气海境一重，之所以一直在闭关，是因为林炎在吸收了五彩吞天蟒的精血后，居然得到了精血之中的先天禀赋--五彩之毒！
五彩吞天蟒，拥有剧毒！
这是天然禀赋。
非常强大。
而林炎则在这段时间里，尝试将五彩之毒融入到自己的战斗方式之中，逐渐研究出了一套战斗之法。
噗嗤！
林炎屈指一弹，一抹五彩指芒射向院子里的一块巨石，瞬间那比钢铁还坚固的石头，被融化出了一个拇指粗的小穴。
看着那小穴，林炎脸上露出满意之色，而后看向院子外：
“五彩之毒也熟悉的差不多了，是时候测试一下实战效果了。”
早在半个月之前，他就察觉到了李山几人的到来，不过他却没有出关，不是害怕，而是要故意晾着对方。
既然想找他麻烦，那他自然也不会让这些人太痛快。
嘎吱！
推开门，林炎走了出去。
外界，李山几人瞧见林炎现身，先是一喜，而后几人的脸上就都露出了森然杀意：
“小子，终于出来了吗？我还以为你真要龟缩一辈子呢！”
“诸位师兄，不知道你们找我做什么？”
林炎一脸微笑看向李山四人。
“我乃李山，外山优秀弟子，找你来，自然是因为王长东师兄想见你。”
李山冷哼一声。

“既然想见我，那让他来就是。”
林炎淡笑。
“王师兄想见你，自然是要你过去，你算什么东西，也想让王师兄亲自来？”
王水不屑冷笑。
“我没时间去见你们什么王师兄。”
林炎摇头。
“要不要见王师兄，不是你说了算，你既然不愿乖乖服从，那我们就将你双腿打断，将你抓过去。”
李山探出一只大手，朝着林炎探了过来。
“你们这样乱来，没有宗门规矩限制吗？”
林炎诧异。
据他所知，宗门内是不允许随意杀戮的。
“我们不会杀了你，最多只会打断你的双腿和双手，让你成为废人，宗门也奈何不了我们。”
李山冷笑。
“原来如此，这么说来，我只要给你们四个人留下一口气，就没事了？”
林炎若有所思的点头，这话引得李山等四大高手都震怒：
“狂妄的小子，就凭你还想跟我们四大高手相争？你以为你是谁啊？你觉得闯个修炼塔，就真的能自比王长东师兄了？修炼塔是修炼塔，只能说明同阶战力，并不能说明实力！”
“狂妄是需要付出代价的！等会我将你拿下，废掉你的双腿双脚，你就知道得罪我们的下场了！”
李山也一脸森然，那大手遮笼而下。
而林炎则杵在原地，一步未动，好似没有防备似的。
“这小子怎么不反抗？”
content_en:
For half a month, Lin Yan had been immersed in seclusion.
In fact, the opening of the Qi Sea was completed seven days ago. Lin Yan has already entered the first level of the Qi Sea Realm. The reason why he has been in retreat is because after Lin Yan absorbed the essence and blood of the five-color sky-swallowing python, he actually obtained the innate talent in the essence and blood - the five-color poison!
The colorful sky-swallowing python is extremely poisonous!
This is a natural gift.
Very powerful.
During this period of time, Lin Yan tried to integrate the colorful poison into his fighting style, and gradually developed a set of fighting methods.
Poof!
Lin Yan flicked his fingers and shot a colorful finger light towards a huge stone in the yard. In an instant, the stone, which was stronger than steel, was melted to create a small hole as thick as a thumb.
Looking at the little hole, Lin Yan showed a look of satisfaction on his face, and then looked out of the yard:
"I'm almost familiar with the colorful poison. It's time to test the actual combat effect."
As early as half a month ago, he had noticed the arrival of Li Shan and others, but he did not leave, not because he was afraid, but because he wanted to deliberately let them go.
Since he wanted to cause trouble for him, he naturally wouldn't make these people too happy.
Crunch!
Opening the door, Lin Yan walked out.
Outside, when Li Shan and others saw Lin Yan's appearance, they were overjoyed at first, and then their faces showed murderous intent:
"Boy, have you finally come out? I thought you were really going to be a turtle for the rest of your life!"
"Brothers, I don't know what you want from me?"
Lin Yan looked at Li Shan and the others with a smile on his face.
"I am Li Shan, an outstanding disciple of Waishan. I came to you naturally because Senior Brother Wang Changdong wants to see you."
Li Shan snorted coldly.
"Since he wants to see me, let him come."
Lin Yan smiled lightly.
"Senior Brother Wang wants to see you, so naturally he wants you to come over. Who do you think you are? You want Senior Brother Wang to come in person?"
Wang Shui sneered disdainfully.
"I don't have time to see you, Senior Brother Wang."
Lin Yan shook his head.
"It's not up to you whether you want to see Senior Brother Wang or not. Since you don't want to obey, then we will break your legs and take you over."
Li Shan stretched out a big hand and reached towards Lin Yan.
"Are you not restricted by the sect's rules when you act like this?"
Lin Yan was surprised.
As far as he knew, random killing was not allowed within the sect.
"We won't kill you. At most, we will break your legs and hands and make you a useless person. The sect can't do anything to us."
Li Shan sneered.
"I see. So, as long as I give the four of you a breath, everything will be fine?"
Lin Yan nodded thoughtfully. These words made Li Shan and other four masters furious:
"Arrogant boy, you still want to compete with our four masters? Who do you think you are? Do you think that by entering a training tower, you can really compare yourself to senior brother Wang Changdong? The training tower is a training tower. It can only show the same level of combat power, but not the strength!"
"You need to pay a price for arrogance! When I take you down later and destroy your legs and feet, you will know the consequences of offending us!"
Li Shan also had a serious look on his face, and his big hand came down to cover the cage.
Lin Yan, on the other hand, stayed in place, not moving a step, as if he was defenseless.
"Why doesn't this kid resist?"
